- [EVENT] User is planning a trip to Chicago next month on United Airlines.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Economy Plus is a premium economy product on United Airlines, offering more legroom, wider seats, and priority boarding.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Economy Plus seats are located at the front of the economy cabin, typically in rows 7-21 on most aircraft.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Economy Plus offers up to 5 inches (13 cm) more legroom compared to standard economy seats, with a seat pitch of 34-37 inches (86-94 cm).
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Economy Plus seats are up to 1 inch (2.5 cm) wider than standard economy seats.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Economy Plus passengers board the plane before standard economy passengers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Economy Plus passengers have access to dedicated overhead bin space.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Economy Plus passengers can enjoy complimentary drinks on flights that offer them.
- [PREFERENCE] User is interested in whether the Economy Plus upgrade is worth it.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors to consider for the Economy Plus upgrade include long-haul flights, taller or larger passengers, frequent flyers, and budget.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The cost of upgrading to Economy Plus varies: $20-$50 per segment for domestic flights and $30-$100 per segment for international flights.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] MileagePlus members may receive discounts on Economy Plus upgrades.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Upgrades can be made during booking, at check-in, or after booking through United's website or mobile app.
